title: AI PM Learning Roadmap
summary: The article presents a structured self-learning roadmap for aspiring AI Product Managers, covering nine key areas from prompt engineering to career resources. It argues that AI PM is a subset of traditional PM but requires greater technical depth, heavier use of AI tools, and familiarity with AI-specific concepts like RAG, evals, and agentic workflows. The author, Aakash Gupta, positions this free roadmap as a superior alternative to expensive paid courses.
key_claims: AI PM is a subset of traditional PM but requires greater technical depth and heavier use of AI tools than conventional product management.
Prompt engineering is described as the number one skill for building great agents and improving productivity.
RAG should be used when retrieving specific knowledge or documents, fine-tuning for specialized domains, and prompting for simple general tasks.
Common mistakes when building AI products include having no fallback strategy, ignoring latency and cost, building without evals, and overfitting to demos.
Breaking into AI PM requires building a portfolio, updating resume and LinkedIn, getting referrals, and being prepared for vibe coding and AI ethics interviews.
